name: ScrollGuard — Multi-Platform Doomscroll Blocker
description: Hides Shorts, Reels, and infinite-scroll feeds across YouTube, Instagram, X, Reddit, and TikTok in one extension. No account requ...

_permission_justifications.storage: Stores per-site on/off toggles, custom hide-selector rules (Pro), the daily-activity dates used for streak tracking, and the Stripe paid-status cache in chrome.storage.local/sync. No feed content or browsing history is ever stored or transmitted.
_permission_justifications.activeTab: Lets the popup read which of the five supported sites the current tab is on (so it can show the right toggle) only at the moment the user opens the popup. No persistent tab monitoring or URL access happens outside of that.
_permission_justifications.host_permissions: Required so the content script that hides Shorts/Reels/feed elements runs automatically on youtube.com, instagram.com, x.com/twitter.com, reddit.com, and tiktok.com. The script only removes visual clutter via CSS/DOM and never reads or sends page content anywhere.
